title: Northwind Logistics · entering cross-border e-commerce delivery, 2027
subtitle: SWOT Analysis · Albert Humphrey, SRI

strengths: On-time delivery of 97.2% over the last 12 months
Own fleet of 640 vans with telematics in every one
Hubs on both sides of the Channel, licensed for customs
Nine years of stop-level delivery data
Customer churn of 6% a year, half the sector average
weaknesses: Brand barely known outside the UK
Shipper portal still on a 2016 codebase
No Sunday or evening delivery yet
Dependence on 3 customers for 28% of revenue
opportunities: UK-EU e-commerce growing 11% a year with customs still confusing sellers
CSRD makes large retailers ask suppliers for carbon per shipment
Two regional rivals up for sale in the Benelux
City low-emission zones favour our electric vans
threats: National posts cutting parcel prices by up to 9%
Amazon Shipping opening to third-party sellers
Driver shortage pushing wages up 7% a year
Diesel van bans in Amsterdam and Brussels from 2027
